= Personnel Training Matrix =

This page shows training status across personnel and equipment, demonstrating the interconnection between personnel, equipment, and certifications.

== Personnel and Their Equipment Authorizations ==

This shows which equipment each person is authorized to use:

{{#ask:
[[Category:Personnel]]
[[Status::Active]]
|?Equipment Authorization
|?Personnel Role
|?Certification
|format=table
|link=all
|headers=plain
|mainlabel=Personnel
|order=ASC
|sort=Personnel Role
|limit=100
}}

== Equipment and Authorized Personnel ==

This shows which personnel are authorized to use each piece of equipment:

{{#ask:
[[Category:Equipment]]
[[Status::Active]]
|?Equipment Authorization
|format=broadtable
|link=all
|headers=plain
|mainlabel=Equipment
|order=ASC
|sort=Equipment Type
}}

== Personnel and Their Certifications ==

{{#ask:
[[Category:Personnel]]
[[Status::Active]]
|?Certification
|?Personnel Role
|format=table
|link=all
|headers=plain
|mainlabel=Personnel
|order=ASC
|sort=Personnel Role
|limit=100
}}

== Training Gaps ==

Equipment that requires certifications but personnel may not have them:

{{#ask:
[[Category:Equipment]]
[[Status::Active]]
|?Required Certification
|?Equipment Authorization
|format=table
|link=all
|headers=plain
|mainlabel=Equipment
|order=ASC
|sort=Equipment Type
}}
